core_idea: S Corp. Ch'unokkun Hong Lu is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Poise is a self-buff: on hit it rolls a Potency-based crit for 1.2x damage. Support passive (**Scouring Hunterband [推刷巾]**) keys off **deployment order** — set your main carry as #1 deployed before the fight.
playstyle_guide: - **Scouring Hunterband [推刷巾]** watches the **#1 deployed ally** — arrange the dashboard so the intended carry is first in line. - Skills check **6+ Bleed** — favour those coins when stacked. - Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Hunter's Scouring** — **S1 — Constricting Ohra Bonds** adds **+3 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+4 Poise** per **On Hit** coin; **S2 — Avulsion Slash** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+2 Poise** per **On Hit** coin. - **Hunter's Scouring** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up. - **Haste** raises Speed for next turn — several bonuses here require being faster than the target. - Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn; coordinate team burst on the next turn. - S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you. **S1 — Constricting Ohra Bonds** (BP 2, CP +3, 3 coins): rolls — low 2, high 11 (Slightly Low). - Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Bleed on target) (max 2); [On Use] If target has Trussed — Hong Lu —, Final Power +1; [On Use] Gain +3 Poise Count - Gain 4 Poise; [On Hit] Inflict +2 Bleed Count **S2 — Avulsion Slash** (BP 4, CP +6, 1 coin): rolls — low 4, high 10 (Extremely Low). - Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Bleed on target) (max 2); [On Use] If target has Trussed — Hong Lu —, Final Power +1; [On Use] Gain +2 Poise Count **S3 — Hunter's Scouring** (BP 4, CP +3, 4 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low). - converts coins to Unbreakable under condition Combat passive — **Ch'unokkun**: If a target has Trussed — Hong Lu —, gain Prisoner Transport Arrangements (Hong Lu). - When chaining Skills, if there is an enemy this unit has inflicted Trussed — Hong Lu — on, then this unit can redirect that enemy's Attac…. Combat passive — **Spiteful Pursuit**: When 1 ally with the earliest Deployment order attacks an enemy that has Bind, deal +10% damage. Defense skill — **Counter: Throwing the Ohra Bond**: [Clashable Counter]. - [On Use] At 6+ (Poise on self + Bleed on target), Clash Power +2. - [On Use] Gain 5 Poise. - [Clash Win] Gain +3 Poise Count.
